entities.summary: Joseph Sarsfield Glass, C.M. was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Salt Lake in Utah from 1915 until his death in 1926. He was a member of the Congregation of the Mission (Vincentians)
